description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three evaluation settings: an unlabeled baseline (gray bar, no value shown), Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, with accuracy (%) on the vertical axis ranging from 0 to 70 in increments of 10. MMAU (blue bars) consistently outperforms MMAR (purple bars) in all labeled categories: on Audio-Reasoner, MMAU achieves approximately 61% accuracy versus MMAR’s ~36%; on Qwen-2.5-Omni, MMAU reaches ~65% while MMAR scores ~56%. The first category, represented by a gray bar with no associated model label or value, appears to serve as a placeholder or baseline with no reported accuracy. The chart visually emphasizes MMAU’s superior performance across both reasoning frameworks, with the largest performance gap occurring in the Audio-Reasoner setting. The legend in the top-left corner identifies the blue and purple bars as MMAU and MMAR, respectively.
